comment: Limits of docs/architecture/m1-build-spec.md section 9, read by tools/perf_map.gd. class: cpu = the fill, swap and rebuild times (CPU side, fail the run), mem = memory (fails the run), gpu = frame times (fail only with --gpu-limits, on real hardware). Never read by a GUT test.

frame_worst_ms.what: worst frame at any zoom while panning

frame_mean_ms.what: mean frame at any zoom while panning

fill_first_ms.what: first slice of the fill (the screen at the camera), CPU time

fill_all_ms.what: whole map filled, CPU time of the slices

build_action_ms.what: one build: MapCells.of_hex and set_tile for the touched hexes, worst of the samples

season_swap_ms.what: swap to a season that was requested ahead: load_season and set_season, worst

chunk_rebuild_ms.what: EdgeLines.for_chunk and set_chunk_lines for one chunk, worst

cells_static_mb.what: static memory of the filled cells

video_mb_per_season.what: video memory of one season's TileSet (the standard's budget for the map)
